description: This Java abstract class 'AbstractPatternValidator' provides functionality to validate character sequences against a regex pattern, with constraints on length and custom error messaging.

classes.name: AbstractPatternValidator
classes.description: An abstract class implementing pattern validation logic for character sequences, ensuring length constraints and pattern matching, with customizable error messages.

methods.name: <init>
methods.description: Constructor initializing the validator with an id, pattern, and error message.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if the id's length is within the maximum allowed and if it matches the pattern; sets reason for failure if applicable.

methods.name: getReason
methods.description: Returns an optional explanation for why validation failed, if any.
